method.label: Find the largest draw that fails

annotationRationale: The method proves a universal upper bound for draws avoiding the target and exhibits a draw attaining that bound, establishing the minimum guarantee.
sourceMethod: Follows the official maximum-failing-draw argument, explicitly explaining both why 75 can fail and why 76 must succeed.

review.mathCheck: Every unsuccessful draw has at most 14 red, 14 green, 14 yellow, 13 blue, 11 white, and 9 black balls, totaling 75. These counts are attainable, so 75 is insufficient and 76 guarantees success, choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded, faithful adaptation of numbered MAA solution 4's maximum-unsuccessful-draw argument. It explicitly proves both the universal bound and its attainability.
review.annotationCheck: The selected extremal concept captures the actual method. Availability limits for every color and the minimum-guarantee endpoint are fully addressed.
